error_reason: When tasked to fetch the official 2020 Domestic top 10 list, the WebSurfer stayed on the Worldwide page and merely sorted it by domestic gross (URL remained /year/world/2020/?sort=domesticGrossToDate). This is not the dedicated Domestic list page and led to extracting the wrong set, causing the incorrect overlap count. Correctly navigating to the Domestic 2020 page (/year/2020/ with the proper Domestic/Calendar view) would have provided the accurate top 10 and prevented the final error.

hypotheses.rationale: The WebSurfer did not actually navigate to or extract the dedicated 'Domestic 2020' top 10 list page from Box Office Mojo; instead it resorted the worldwide table by domestic gross on the same page. This can mislead the following comparison because the correct domestic top 10 list is a separate list (year/2020/?grossesOption=calendarGrosses for Domestic) and differs from a domestic-sorted worldwide page. This earliest misstep seeded the Assistant’s later incorrect overlap count.
hypotheses.check: Verify whether step 12 accessed the proper Box Office Mojo page for 'Domestic 2020' top 10 (e.g., /year/2020/?grossesOption=calendarGrosses or /year/2020/ with Domestic tab) versus just resorting the worldwide table. Compare the list visible in step 8 (world list) and the content actually obtained at step 12 with the official Domestic 2020 top 10 page. Confirm that relying on the resorted worldwide page caused incorrect domestic top 10 data.

evidence.discrepancy: Step 12 claims action 'I clicked "Domestic"' but remains on the worldwide page with a domesticGrossToDate sort (year/world/2020/?sort=domesticGrossToDate). It did not navigate to the proper Domestic 2020 list page (such as /year/2020/ with Domestic/Calendar view). Consequently, the data used in Step 16 for the domestic top 10 was derived from a resorted worldwide table, not the official domestic top 10 list.
